n5698b01d9f.headline: Nissan resigns to drastic staff reduction to survive
n5698b01d9f.summary: Japanese automaker Nissan is preparing to announce drastic staff reductions exceeding 10,000 jobs as part of painful reforms to stabilize its financial situation.
n5698b01d9f.why: Nissan is a major global car manufacturer whose restructuring and cost-cutting efforts impact the automotive sector and investor confidence in Japanese industry.

n4f9682ab2e.headline: These South African Rand Bonds Would Yield Well Even After Currency Risk
n4f9682ab2e.summary: South African rand-denominated supranational bonds provide attractive yields even after accounting for currency risk and zero credit risk.
n4f9682ab2e.why: South Africa's bond market is significant for emerging market investors seeking yield, with currency risk being a key consideration for foreign investors.
